answer: An agent economy can issue each identity one anonymous credential per epoch, backed by a nullifier: every action reveals only a fresh nullifier, never the identity, so one agent cannot vote twice, while a sybil farmer must buy a separate credential for each fake. Think of the nullifier as a ridge line—cross it once and the pass is spent; old credentials become a relic, useless after the epoch ends. Even a swarm hiding in the karst of the network, with countless cracks to slip through, is forced to pay full price for every extra voice, which makes mass forgery unprofitable.
